title: •Bossk
caption: •Bossk (V)
game_text: {pilot:2}. While at same site as a smuggler, power +3. While with opponent’s smuggler or Wookiee, opponent may not draw more than one battle destiny here. Immune to attrition < number of opponent’s smugglers on table.
lore: Male Trandoshan bounty hunter. Strong but clumsy. Extremely proud and arrogant. Suffered a humiliating defeat at the hands of Chewbacca and his partner Han Solo.
